programs.description: A man returns to his village for a fresh start and to sell a piece of his land. Soon, he falls for a young woman on the way, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.
Anupamaa loves her husband and her family, but she does not get the respect she deserves. Later, when she discovers her husband's affair, she decides to live life on her own terms.
After Bhoomi and Ajith tie the knot out of convenience, they strive to build a bond and draw strength from each other in tough situations.
The familiar routines of Swati and her family crumble when her father passes away. Amid financial issues, betrayal and hurdles of responsibility, Swati must rebuild the family.
A man returns to his village for a fresh start and to sell a piece of his land. Soon, he falls for a young woman on the way, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.
With her quick wit and visionary approach, Lalitha becomes the village head. However, the real challenge arises when she is confronted with family politics.
The lives of two ordinary people, Surya and Meena, collide. While the former is aimless with no hope in life, the latter smiles through adversities and makes sacrifices for her family's happiness.
